mainEntity.name: What types of plants are best for a water-wise landscape in Los Angeles and Pasadena?

acceptedAnswer.text: For Los Angeles and Pasadena, native California plants and Mediterranean-climate adapted species are excellent choices for water-wise landscapes. Popular options include various salvias (sages), lavender, rosemary, ceanothus (California lilac), manzanita, and certain ornamental grasses. Succulents and cacti are also highly drought-tolerant. These plants are well-suited to the region's climate, require minimal supplemental water once established, and thrive with less intervention, contributing to a vibrant and sustainable garden.
